responsibility: This master definition file lists GCC’s built-in functions and their metadata in a declarative form. For each builtin it records the enum code, exposed names, builtin class, type IDs from builtin-types.def, fallback and language-visibility properties, default attribute list from builtin-attrs.def, implicit-creation policy, and target conditions, thereby driving generation of builtin enums, name tables, declarations, and registration logic across the compiler.
same_name_distinction: Declaration table in the `builtins` group: it enumerates builtin IDs, names, classes, types, attributes, and registration conditions, driving generated tables; unlike `gcc/builtins.cc`, which implements expansion logic, and `gcc/builtins.h`, which declares the interface.
